scope: Post-run source-only precision audit. No inference/training/model selection repeated; frozen protocol/raw/artifacts unchanged.
pipeline: Production-compatible image_tensor.tensor builds normalized FP32 BGR48 values
data.arrays converts normalized values to numpy.float16 for RAM storage
train.py converts each stored development array back to float32 before every original/reduced/trained evaluation
Training batch assignment converts stored float16 values into float32
candidateInputPolicy: All original-full18710, reduced-untrained, epoch4 and epoch8 development candidates receive the same stored FP16-rounded values. Relative comparisons are valid for that declared-by-source input condition.
nextMediumPolicy: Native preprocessing input and cached feature/logit values remain float32 throughout; medium initialization fidelity already used float32.
